entry.title: Shipping disruption continues in a key strait
entry.summary: Commercial vessels are being redirected as the disruption enters a second week. Fuel prices remain well above their level at the start of the year, and insurers have raised premiums on the route.

entry.title: Two governments propose a temporary shipping channel
entry.content: The proposal would establish a temporary channel and clear the route. It has not yet been accepted by all parties.

entry.title: Trade body reports higher freight costs
entry.summary: Longer alternative routes and higher insurance have pushed costs up across the region.
